read_constant_dynamic_library_suffix: read the DYNAMIC_LIBRARY_SUFFIX constant to get the OS-specific dynamic library extension
read_constant_package_dir: read the PACKAGE_DIR constant to get the package directory as a Path object
read_constant_package_github_url: read the PACKAGE_GITHUB_URL constant to get the GitHub repository URL
read_constant_nonpytorch_doc_url: read the NONPYTORCH_DOC_URL constant to get the non-PyTorch CUDA documentation URL
read_constant_platform_suffix: read the DYNAMIC_LIBRARY_SUFFIX mapping to determine library suffix for the current platform
